corrected_record.support_text: Hepatocyte (≈2.0 × 10^6 cells/mL) suspensions were incubated with DPPD (10 µM) for 10 min before addition of S-(2-chloroethyl)-DL-cysteine (7.5 mM); viability assessed after 3.0 h. DPPD inhibited CEC cytotoxicity by 88 ± 6% by trypan blue exclusion and 98 ± 2% by LDH release.
corrected_record.assay_and_readout: trypan blue exclusion and LDH release—% inhibition of CEC-induced cytotoxicity
corrected_record.exposure_duration_and_schedule: 10 min preincubation, then CEC (7.5 mM); assessed at 3.0 h
corrected_record.result_value: inhibited CEC-induced cytotoxicity by 88 ± 6% (trypan blue) and 98 ± 2% (LDH)
corrected_record.extra_details: DPPD = N,N'-diphenyl-p-phenylenediamine, an antioxidant added as protective cotreatment against CEC (7.5 mM) challenge. Mean ± SD of three experiments. DPPD also prevented lipid peroxidation and maintained viability for 2.5 h in CEC-treated cells, with no effect on control hepatocytes. The original abstract identifies DPPD as N,N'-diphenyl-p-phenylenediamine and reports no protection against cell death at 4 h. Preserve the extracted earlier protective observation within its stated timing; it is not sustained protection. The exact extracted 3 h percentages have not been independently checked against a full original table.

decisions.reason: DPPD is N,N'-diphenyl-p-phenylenediamine in the original CEC paper; the source instead expands and binds it to 1,3-diphenylisobenzofuran.

corrected_record.support_text: Hepatocytes were treated with or without AICAR (200μM, 24hrs). Confocal images indicated that more hepatocytes had interconnected mitochondrial network when treated with AICAR, whereas many control hepatocytes had less interconnected mitochondrial network and mainly contained a mixture of fused and fragmented mitochondria.
corrected_record.assay_and_readout: confocal microscopy of mitochondrial network morphology (TMRE and MitoTracker Green staining)
corrected_record.biological_model_context: Primary rat hepatocytes in collagen sandwich culture
corrected_record.extra_details: Focal molecule: AICAR (AICA ribonucleotide), role AMPK activator. AICAR 200 μM, 24 h promoted mitochondrial fusion/interconnected network, associated with increased Mfn1 (145%) and Opa1 (132%) without affecting Mfn2, Drp1 activity, or structure proteins Hsp60/Cox4/Tom20. The measured endpoint is mitochondrial network morphology, not canalicular morphology. The original Methods name Sigma AICAR as 5-aminoimidazole-4-carboxamide ribonucleotide without a catalog number; riboside versus phosphorylated test-form identity is not independently resolved. Preserve the source-associated structure as uncertain rather than infer a replacement. The fused-network observation remains a bounded mechanistic finding.

decisions.reason: The readout is AICAR-associated mitochondrial network morphology, currently placed in L4; it belongs to mitochondrial evidence. The identity question is unresolved; no riboside substitution is made.
